name: atlas-opendata-13tev-lepton-jet-large-r-raw
source: Raw per-event array over the ATLAS Open Data 13 TeV ntuple branches (https://opendata.atlas.cern/docs/documentation/data_format/ntuple): two leptons and four jets as (pt, eta, phi, E), the leading large-R jet as (pt, eta, phi, E, m), then missing momentum, weights and scale factors. Positional entries are in stored order and NaN padded; no sorting or selection is applied.
